relations.statement: For a unit vector Omega in H=(C^2)^{⊗n} and site set A, A(A)Omega = H iff the reduced state of Omega on A^c has full rank 2^|A^c| iff Omega is separating for A(A^c). Equivalently A(A)Omega = H_A tensor range of the complementary marginal, of dimension 2^|A| r, where r is the Schmidt rank across A and A^c.
relations.hypotheses: Omega a unit vector over Q(i); A a subset of the n sites; A(A) the full matrix algebra on A acting as M tensor identity.

lemmas.statement: Dimension of A(A)Omega is 2^|A| * r, where r is the Schmidt rank of Omega across A and A^c. It is the rank of the reduced state on A^c.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem dim_orbit_eq (n : ℕ) : True := by trivial -- placeholder; the real statement needs a definition of A(A)Omega that is not available

lemmas.statement: A(A)Omega = H iff the Schmidt rank r across A and A^c equals 2^|A^c|. This is equivalent to the reduced state on A^c having full rank, and to Omega being separating for A(A^c).
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem cyclic_iff_full_rank (n : ℕ) : True := by trivial -- placeholder

near_misses.claim: The three-qubit GHZ vector is cyclic for some single site.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The marginal on the two remaining sites has rank 2, not 4, so the Schmidt rank across a single site is 2 and 2*2=4 is less than 8.

near_misses.claim: A product vector is cyclic for a proper subset A of the sites.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Schmidt rank across A and A^c is 1, so the marginal on A^c has rank 1, which is less than 2^|A^c| when A^c is nonempty.

open_obligations: No existing declaration formalizes A(A)Omega, the reduced state, or separating vectors; all are proposed_new.
The Lean proof of the general-n equivalence is open, and the skeletons are placeholders.
The GHZ and W pair-cyclicity ranks need exact computation: a pair has a single complementary site, so full rank means a rank-2 marginal.
The relation of TensorSchmidt.exists_schmidt_bases to the Schmidt decomposition over Q(i) is not established; it is stated over C.
No generators are grounded; the OpenSet declarations are not related to the quantum target.
